source_dir.description: The source directory to scan for MP3, OGG, and FLAC files.

compilation.description: Enable --compilation mode to sort compilations as ALBUM/FILENAME.

keepdupes.description: Enable --keepdupes to keep both duplicates, naming the last one with a suffix.

largest.description: Enable --largest to remove the smallest file when duplicates are found.

noremove.description: Enable --noremove to ignore the last duplicate file found.

case_insensitive.description: Enable --insensitive for case-insensitive directory name searches.

consistent.description: Enable --consistent for consistent, case-normalized directory names.

allowspecial.description: Enable --allowspecial to keep special characters in names.

silentskip.description: Enable --silentskip to suppress messages about skipped files.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level. 0: normal, 1: verbose, 2: very verbose. Corresponds to -v.

quiet.description: Enable --quiet to suppress all status messages.

dry_run.description: Enable --dry-run to preview actions without making changes.

no_cache.description: Enable --no-cache to disable file information caching.

refresh_cache.description: Enable --refresh-cache to write new info to cache without reading old.

clean_cache.description: Enable --cleancache to remove dangling and expired cache entries.

clean_tree.description: Enable --cleantree to remove empty directories in the tree.
